meta.title: World of Warcraft: Forever
meta.notes: Rogue is fully reconstructed from a supplied screenshot. Paladin Holy, Protection, and Retribution are now fully reconstructed from a supplied composite screenshot. Enhancement Shaman is populated from the supplied 18-talent table. Warrior remains partial pending directly readable screenshots. Multi-rank tooltip arrays were added for 95 talents by inferring sensible rank progressions from the available rank-1 tooltip values. These inferred per-rank values are not additional leak evidence and should be replaced if exact Forever rank screenshots become available. Vindication remains in legacy max_rank format because its source tooltip does not contain enough numeric information to infer distinct ranks safely.

known_fragments.text: All three Paladin talent trees are now populated from a supplied BlizzCon 2026 composite. Notable Forever nodes include Light's Vigil, Voice of Truth, Consecrated Ground, Improved Seal of Fury, Templar's Bulwark, Iron Creed, Sacred Arbiter, Champion of the Light, Instrument of Law, and Twist of Light.
Beast Mastery has Summon Hawk support. Marksmanship has a Lone Wolf talent reported as +20% damage while playing without a pet.

All three Rogue talent trees are now transcribed into the clickable calculator from a supplied BlizzCon 2026 screenshot. The tree includes new or heavily revised nodes such as Mutilate, Venom, Hack and Slash, Restless Blades, Quietus, Cutthroat, and Thousand Cuts.

Enhancement is now populated with 18 supplied talents, including Spirit Weapons, Stormstrike, Improved Stormstrike, Maelstrom Weapon, Mental Quickness, and Rage of the Farseer. Elemental and Restoration still await full captures.

A public screenshot album claims to capture the complete Warrior talent set. Improved Heroic Strike is publicly discussed as remaining in Arms, and Improved Intercept has appeared in public tree material. Victory Rush is also reported added. Full node transcription still needs directly readable screenshots.
known_fragments.source: BlizzCon 2026 public Warrior screenshot collection and demo reports

known_fragments.text: The talent trees are revised; Improved Mark of the Wild was specifically reported removed from its old place. Druids also have a normal out-of-combat resurrection ability.
Show-floor captures indicate meaningful Affliction/Demonology/Destruction changes. Community discussion mentions Incinerate access in Demonology and new Shadow-damage stacking possibilities.
A complete verified text transcription of the Forever Mage tree is not included in this initial research snapshot.
A complete verified text transcription of the Forever Priest tree is not included in this initial research snapshot.
